info.name: dhs NMOS Node + Registry
info.description: HTTP surfaces of the dhs AMWA NMOS implementation: the Node provider (IS-04/05/07/08/11/14 + the standalone IS-09 System server) and the Registry (IS-04 Registration + Query APIs) plus the registry mirror status endpoint. Every request URL is derived from the Go route registrations in internal/amwa/provider/ and internal/amwa/registry/ — see docs/postman/README.md for the variable table and the WebSocket endpoints this collection cannot carry (IS-12 /x-nmos/ncp/v1.0, IS-07 /x-nmos/events/v1.0/ws, Query API subscription sockets).

item.name: IS-04 Node API
item.description: AMWA IS-04 Node API served by `dhs producer nmos serve` (internal/amwa/provider/node.go, default bind :8080). Read-only resource graph plus the legacy PUT /receivers/{id}/target.

request.description: Lists the NMOS API trees this host serves (IS-04 v1.3 §4 API root).
Lists the Node API version subtrees served.
Node API index: self/, devices/, sources/, flows/, senders/, receivers/.
The Node resource itself (IS-04 Node API /self).
Lists every Device on the Node.
One Device by UUID; 404 for unknown ids.
Lists every Source on the Node.
One Source by UUID.
Lists every Flow on the Node.
One Flow by UUID.
Lists every Sender on the Node.
One Sender by UUID.
The Sender's SDP transport file; Content-Type application/sdp (404 for MXL senders, which carry no transport file per BCP-007-03).
Lists every Receiver on the Node.
One Receiver by UUID.
IS-04 §4.3.1 legacy connection control: body is a Sender JSON object; answers 202 Accepted. v1.2+ recommends IS-05 instead.
IS-04 §4.3.1: an empty object body disconnects the Receiver; answers 202 Accepted.

item.name: IS-05 Connection API
item.description: AMWA IS-05 Connection Management API served alongside the Node API on the same listener (internal/amwa/provider/connection.go). Every registered minor (v1.0/v1.1/v1.2) is mounted in parallel; switch {{is05_ver}} to pick one.

request.description: Lists the mounted Connection API version subtrees.
Connection API index: bulk/, single/.
Single-endpoint index: receivers/, senders/.
Lists the connection-managed Sender ids.
Per-sender index: constraints/, staged/, active/, transportfile/, transporttype/.
Transport parameter constraints for this Sender (IS-05 single sender constraints).
The Sender's staged (pending) transport parameters and activation state.
The Sender's active transport parameters.
The Sender's base transport URN (e.g. urn:x-nmos:transport:rtp).
The Sender's SDP; Content-Type application/sdp. Byte-identical to the IS-04 manifest_href route (both render from one generator).
Stages transport parameters without activating (IS-05 stage-then-activate pattern).
Activates the staged parameters immediately and enables the Sender (master_enable gates the endpoint).
Lists the connection-managed Receiver ids.
Per-receiver index: constraints/, staged/, active/, transporttype/ (no transportfile — receivers accept SDP, they never serve it).
Transport parameter constraints for this Receiver.
The Receiver's staged transport parameters and activation state.
The Receiver's active transport parameters.
The Receiver's base transport URN.
Stages a connection to a Sender: sender_id plus the Sender's SDP in transport_file.data.
Activates the staged connection immediately with master_enable=true.
Bulk-endpoint index: receivers/, senders/.
Bulk staging: an array of {id, params}; the response is a per-id status array (bulk endpoints are POST-only — GET answers 405).
Bulk staging for receivers; same array-of-{id, params} shape.

item.name: IS-07 Events
item.description: AMWA IS-07 Event & Tally REST API (internal/amwa/provider/events.go). The push side is the WebSocket at /x-nmos/events/{ver}/ws (not representable in Postman collections of this format — see README).

request.description: Lists the mounted Events API version subtrees.
Events API index: sources/.
Lists the event source ids.
Per-source index: type/, state/.
The source's event type definition.
The source's current event state.

item.name: IS-14 Configuration
item.description: AMWA IS-14 Device Configuration API — the rolePaths view of the MS-05 device model (internal/amwa/provider/configuration.go + configuration_mount.go). The same model is also served over the IS-12 WebSocket at /x-nmos/ncp/v1.0 (see README).

request.description: Lists the mounted Configuration API version subtrees.
API index: rolePaths/.
Lists every role path in the device model (root and its blocks).
Per-role-path index: bulkProperties/, descriptor/, methods/, properties/.
The MS-05 class descriptor for the object at this role path.
Lists the property ids (level p index form, e.g. 1p6) on this object.
Per-property index: descriptor/, value/.
The property's datatype descriptor.
The property's current value wrapped in an NcMethodResult.
Writes the property (readonly properties refuse with NcMethodStatus 405).
Lists the method ids (level m index form, e.g. 1m1) on this object.
Invokes a method; arguments must be a JSON object (empty for parameterless methods).
Reads the bulk properties dataSet for this subtree.
Restores a bulk properties dataSet; arguments requires dataSet, recurse and restoreMode.
Validates a bulk properties dataSet against the model without applying it; same body shape as PUT.

item.name: Registry - Registration API
item.description: IS-04 Registration API — the Registry's Node-facing face, served by `dhs registry nmos serve` (internal/amwa/registry/registration.go, default bind :8235). Every registered IS-04 minor is mounted in parallel.

request.description: Lists the API trees the Registry serves: registration/, query/.
Lists the Registration API version subtrees.
Registration API index: resource/, health/.
Registers (or updates) a resource; 201 on create, 200 on update, with a Location header per IS-04 §6.1.1. Body shown is a minimal Node registration.
Reads one registered resource back (any plural works: nodes, devices, sources, flows, senders, receivers).
Explicitly deregisters a resource; 204 on success.
Node heartbeat; 404 tells the Node to re-register (IS-04 heartbeat contract).
Reads the last-heartbeat timestamp for a Node.

item.name: Registry - Query API
item.description: IS-04 Query API — the Registry's Controller-facing face (internal/amwa/registry/query.go). Paged lists carry X-Paging-* and Link headers; filters (id/label/description, query.rql=eq(...), query.downgrade, query.ancestry_*) go in the query string. The subscription WebSocket itself is at ws://<registry>/x-nmos/query/{ver}/subscriptions/{id}/ws.

request.description: Lists the Query API version subtrees.
Query API index: nodes/, devices/, sources/, flows/, senders/, receivers/, subscriptions/.
Paged list of registered Nodes (IS-04 §6.1.6 pagination headers).
Paged list of registered Devices.
Paged list of registered Sources.
Paged list of registered Flows.
Paged list of registered Senders.
Paged list of registered Receivers.
One registered Node by UUID (per-id routes exist for every resource plural).
One registered Sender by UUID.
Lists the active Query API subscriptions.
Creates a WebSocket subscription; the response's ws_href is where the Controller connects.
One subscription by id.
Releases a subscription (only persistent ones may be deleted by clients).

item.name: Registry Mirror
item.description: `dhs registry nmos mirror --status-addr` status endpoint (internal/amwa/registry/mirror_audit.go). The plant default is :9101 on the mirror host (ansible/roles/dhs_amwa_plant/defaults/main.yml).

request.description: Mirror bridge status: source/target, uptime, forward/heartbeat counters, per-collection cache sizes and the recent audit ring.
